title: Maestría en Ciencia Política
institution: El Colegio de México, Centro de Estudios Internacionales (CEI)
about: El Colegio de México's Centre for International Studies has opened its call for the Master's in Political Science. The call opened on 23 October 2026 and closes on 19 February 2027.
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Maestría en Ciencia Política at El Colegio de México, Centro de Estudios Internacionales (CEI), Mexico City, Mexico; deadline 19 Feb 2027. The photo is Mexico's country image, El Castillo at Chichén Itzá, not Mexico City.
